description: Run a JavaScript (ES module) program inside your workspace. It must `export default async function (input) { ... }` and return JSON. Use `import { get } from "codemode:finzdata"` for data and `import fs from "node:fs/promises"` for files under /workspace. No other network access.

input.description: JSON value passed to your default export.
